Class ToonEscapes

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.serde.toon.util.ToonEscapes
@Internal public final class ToonEscapes extends Object
Quote-aware lexical utilities shared by ToonEncoder (encode) and ToonDecoder (decode).
Since:
3.3.0

      public static String unquote(String quoted) throws SerdeException
      Unescapes a fully-quoted token, including its surrounding quote characters, decoding \\ \" \n \r \t and \\u followed by four hex digits.

      Returns:
      The unescaped string value

    • splitByDelimiter

      public static List<String> splitByDelimiter(String s, char delimiter) throws SerdeException
      Splits s on the given delimiter, treating any quoted substring as opaque (a delimiter character inside a quoted token is not a split point), and trims surrounding spaces from each resulting token.
      Parameters:
      s - The string to split
      delimiter - The delimiter to split on
      Returns:
      The tokens, in order
      Throws:
      SerdeException - If a quoted substring is unterminated

    • stripTrailingWhitespace

      public static String stripTrailingWhitespace(String line)
      Strips trailing spaces from the given line. Tabs are deliberately left alone: a tab is a legal delimiter, so a trailing tab on a row/entry line can be significant (an intentionally-empty last cell), not incidental whitespace. This runs once, before any line is known to be a row/entry line rather than a bare scalar or list-item marker; callers that parse a line in a context with no delimiter at all strip a leftover trailing tab themselves once that context is known.
      Parameters:
      line - The line to strip trailing spaces from
      Returns:
      The line without trailing spaces

      Returns:

      Throws:

    • isCommentLine

      public static boolean isCommentLine(String line, int leadingSpaces)
      Returns whether the given line is a full-line comment, i.e. its first non-space character is #. Comment lines are stripped before structural parsing and are exempt from indentation consistency checks applied to every other line.
      Parameters:
      line - The line, with trailing whitespace already stripped
      leadingSpaces - The number of leading space characters in line
      Returns:
      true if the line is a full-line comment

    • looksLikeScalar

      public static boolean looksLikeScalar(String content) throws SerdeException
      Returns whether the given unindented content string represents a scalar value rather than an object field or an array/tabular header (i.e. not beginning with [ or containing an unquoted : or [).
      Parameters:
      content - The line content to check
      Returns:
      true if the content looks like a scalar value
      Throws:
      SerdeException - If the content contains an unterminated quoted string

    • skipSpaces

      public static int skipSpaces(String value, int from)
      Returns the index of the first character at or after from that is not a space. Tabs are not skipped: a tab can be the active delimiter.
      Parameters:
      value - The text to scan
      from - The index to start at
      Returns:
      The index of the first non-space character, or value.length() if there is none
